fieldDescription: Every DTI technology counts as found. Without Ashes of the Domain this unlocks every structure. With it, each technology still needs its AoTD research.
With Ashes of the Domain - Vaults of Knowledge: every found DTI technology is unlocked without AoTD research. Until the quests come, every technology in the AoTD tree counts as found.
What happens to running projects when their colony changes owner. Keep: they go on for the new owner. Pause: they stop until the colony comes back. Remove: the structures are removed.

Off: no Terraforming Control, no terraforming project, and the terraforming research stays locked. Built ones keep working. Turn it off to use the terraforming of another mod, such as TaSC, DIY Planets or Terraforming Made Easy.
